## Adapters

### `adapter_disable`

**slash:** `/adapter:disable`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Adapter.Disable`

**permission:** `adapter.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 暂停 adapter 实例（移到 adapters/_disabled/）— 不会删配置；可用 /adapter:enable 恢复

**args:**
  - `name` (required) — adapter instance name

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — adapter:disable requires args.name
  - `not_found` — no adapter %{name}
  - `already_disabled` — adapter %{name} is already disabled
  - `disable_failed` — %{detail}

### `adapter_enable`

**slash:** `/adapter:enable`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Adapter.Enable`

**permission:** `adapter.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 恢复 adapter 实例（从 adapters/_disabled/ 移回 adapters/）+ refresh

**args:**
  - `name` (required) — adapter instance name

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — adapter:enable requires args.name
  - `not_disabled` — adapter %{name} is not in adapters/_disabled/
  - `already_enabled` — adapter %{name} is already enabled
  - `enable_failed` — %{detail}

**args:** _none_

**errors:** _none declared_

### `adapter_remove`

**slash:** `/adapter:remove`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Adapter.Remove`

**permission:** `adapter.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 终止 adapter 实例（sidecar + FAA peer）并从 adapters/<name>/ 移除

**args:**
  - `instance_id` (required) — adapter 实例 id

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — adapter_remove requires args.instance_id
  - `unknown_instance` — no adapter %{instance_id}

### `adapter_rename`

**slash:** `/adapter:rename`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Adapter.Rename`

**permission:** `adapter.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 重命名 adapter 实例（terminate old + 移动 adapters/<name>/ + refresh）

**args:**
  - `old_instance_id` (required) — 原 instance id
  - `new_instance_id` (required) — 新 instance id（^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$）

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — adapter_rename requires args.old_instance_id and args.new_instance_id
  - `invalid_new_name` — name %{new} fails the adapter-name pattern (no leading `_`, ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$)
  - `old_and_new_match` — old and new must differ
  - `new_name_already_exists` — instance %{new} already exists
  - `unknown_instance` — no adapter %{old}
  - `rename_failed` — %{detail}

### `adapter_start`

_internal kind only — not slash-callable_

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Adapter.Start`

**permission:** `adapter.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 起一个 Python adapter sidecar（不写 adapters.yaml；持久注册请用 register_adapter）

**args:**
  - `type` (required) — adapter 类型（feishu …）
  - `instance_id` (required) — instance id

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — adapter_start requires args.type and args.instance_id
  - `spawn_failed` — ensure_adapter failed: %{detail}

### `register_adapter`

_internal kind only — not slash-callable_

**module:** `Esr.Commands.RegisterAdapter`

**permission:** `adapter.register`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 持久注册 adapter 实例（写 adapters/<name>/config.yaml + 启动 sidecar）

**args:**
  - `type` (required) — adapter 类型（目前只支持 feishu）
  - `name` (required) — instance 名
  - `app_id` (required) — Feishu app_id（cli_xxx）
  - `app_secret` (required) — Feishu app_secret

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — register_adapter requires args.{type="feishu", name, app_id, app_secret}
  - `register_adapter_failed` — %{detail}


## Agents

### `agent_add`

**slash:** `/agent:add`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Agent.Add`

**permission:** `session:default/spawn`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 向当前 session 添加 agent 实例；name 须全局唯一

**args:**
  - `type` (required) — agent type declared by an enabled plugin
  - `name` (required) — globally-unique instance name

**errors:**
  - `no_session_target` — no chat-current session and session_id= not provided; use /session:new or pass session_id=<uuid>
  - `duplicate_agent_name` — agent name '%{name}' already exists in session '%{session_id}' (pick a different name)
  - `spawn_failed` — failed to spawn agent subtree for '%{name}' in session '%{session_id}': %{reason}
  - `unknown_agent_type` — agent type '%{type}' is not declared in any enabled plugin; known types: %{known}
  - `invalid_args` — /agent:add requires args.type and args.name (non-empty strings); session_id= is optional when chat-current is set

**description:** 列当前 chat 当前 session 内运行的 agent 实例

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Agent.Remove`

**permission:** `session:default/spawn`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

### `agent_rename`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Agent.Rename`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 重命名 agent；name=<旧> new_name=<新>

**args:**
  - `name` (required) — current agent name
  - `new_name` (required) — new agent name

**errors:**

  - `duplicate_agent_name` — agent '%{new_name}' already exists in session '%{session_id}' (pick a different name)
  - `invalid_args` — /agent:rename requires args.session_id, args.name, and args.new_name

  - `invalid_args` — /agent:set-primary requires args.session_id and args.name (non-empty strings)

## PTY

### `key`

_internal kind only — not slash-callable_

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Key`

**permission:** `null`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`false` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 把特殊键盘输入（up/down/enter/esc/tab/c-X 等）发到 chat-current session 的 PTY

**args:**
  - `keys` (required) — key spec(s); 例 up enter c-c esc

**errors:**
  - `missing_keys` — usage: /key <keyspec> [<keyspec> …]   examples: /key up enter   /key c-c   /key esc esc
  - `missing_chat_context` — /key needs chat_id + app_id from the inbound envelope
  - `no_session` — no chat-current session in this chat — start one with /new-session first
  - `unknown_key` — unknown key '%{key}'. supported: up/down/left/right, enter, esc, tab, space, bs, c-<letter>
  - `invalid_args` — /key requires args map with keys + chat context

**args:**

**errors:**

  - `discovery_failed` — plugin discovery failed: %{reason}
  - `not_hot_reloadable` — plugin %{plugin} must declare hot_reloadable: true in manifest to support reload; restart esrd to apply config changes
  - `plugin_module_not_found` — expected module %{module} to be loaded for plugin %{plugin}; verify the plugin's Plugin module exists
  - `callback_not_exported` — plugin %{plugin} declares hot_reloadable: true but does not export on_config_change/1; check that the module implements Esr.Plugin.Behaviour

  - `invalid_layer` — invalid layer %{layer}; valid: %{valid}
  - `user_uuid_required` — layer=user requires user_uuid
  - `workspace_id_required` — layer=workspace requires workspace_id

## Sessions

### `session_bind_chat`

**slash:** `/session:bind-chat`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.BindChat`

**permission:** `session.attach`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 把已有 session 加入当前 chat;UUID-only(用 /session:list 查 UUID)

**args:**
  - `session` (required) — session UUID v4

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — /session:bind-chat requires args.session (UUID) and a chat context (chat_id + app_id)
  - `invalid_session_uuid` — session bind-chat requires a UUID; use /session:list to see available sessions
  - `unknown_session` — session '%{session}' not found
  - `not_authorized` — you do not have 'session:%{session}/attach' or 'session:%{session}/admin'; ask the session owner to run /session:share

### `session_branch_end`

_internal kind only — not slash-callable_

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.BranchEnd`

**permission:** `session:default/end`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** tear down a branch worktree (CLI-only; dispatcher kind)

**args:**
  - `branch` (required) — branch name registered in branches.yaml
  - `force` (optional) default=`"false"` — skip cleanup-check handshake

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — session_branch_end requires submitted_by and args.branch (non-empty string)
  - `no_such_branch` — branch %{branch} not registered in branches.yaml
  - `worktree_dirty` — branch %{branch} has uncommitted changes; commit/discard before ending or pass --force
  - `worktree_unpushed` — branch %{branch} has unpushed commits; push first or pass --force
  - `worktree_stashed` — branch %{branch} has stashed changes; review before ending or pass --force
  - `worktree_unknown` — branch %{branch} CC reported unknown status %{status}
  - `cleanup_timeout` — CC session did not respond to cleanup_check within %{timeout_ms}ms (branch %{branch}). Retry, or re-send /end-session with --force to skip the check.
  - `branch_end_failed` — branch end failed: %{details}

### `session_branch_new`

_internal kind only — not slash-callable_

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.BranchNew`

**permission:** `session:default/create`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** spawn an ephemeral esrd for a new branch worktree (CLI-only; dispatcher kind)

**args:**
  - `branch` (required) — branch name to spawn

  - `unknown_session` — session %{session_id} not found
  - `end_failed` — session end failed: %{details}

**args:**
  - `workspace` (optional) — scope by workspace name

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — session_list %{detail}
  - `unknown_workspace` — workspace %{workspace} not found

### `session_new`

**slash:** `/session:new`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.New`

**permission:** `session:default/create`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 起一个新 session(自动 transient workspace);name=<X> [agent=cc]

**args:**
  - `name` (required) — session 名
  - `agent` (optional) default=`"cc"` — agent 名(默认 cc)

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — session_new %{detail}
  - `worktree_failed` — git worktree add failed: %{details}
  - `name_collision` — session name '%{name}' already used by another live session in workspace %{workspace}
  - `worktree_collision` — worktree branch '%{worktree}' already used by another live session in workspace %{workspace}
  - `session_name_taken` — a session named '%{name}' already exists for owner '%{owner_user}'
  - `session_persist_failed` — failed to write session.json for %{session_id}: %{details}
  - `workspace_gone` — workspace %{name} %{detail}
  - `no_workspace_target` — no explicit workspace= and no chat-current binding and no user-default workspace; bind first with /workspace:bind-chat or /user:use, or pass workspace=<name>
  - `unknown_agent` — agent %{agent} not registered in agents.yaml
  - `missing_capabilities` — missing capabilities: %{caps}
  - `session_start_failed` — session start failed: %{details}

### `session_share`

**slash:** `/session:share`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.Share`

**permission:** `cap.manage`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 把 session 访问权授给其他用户;等价于 /cap:grant session:<uuid>/<perm>

**args:**
  - `session` (required) — session UUID v4
  - `user` (required) — target username
  - `perm` (optional) default=`"attach"` — attach | admin

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — /session:share %{detail}
  - `invalid_session_uuid` — session share requires a UUID; use /session:list to see available sessions
  - `invalid_perm` — invalid perm '%{perm}'; valid values are: attach, admin
  - `user_not_found` — no user with username '%{username}' is registered

### `session_switch`

**slash:** `/session:switch`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.Switch`

**permission:** `null`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 切换 chat 当前 session(不解绑其它);session=<uuid>

**args:**
  - `session` (required) — session UUID v4

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — session_switch requires submitted_by + args.session (with chat_id + app_id) OR submitted_by + args.branch (legacy DI-10)
  - `no_such_target` — no such target
  - `not_attached` — session %{session_id} is not attached to this chat — use /session:attach session=%{session_id} first
  - `switch_failed` — could not switch chat-current session to %{session_id}: %{reason}
  - `write_failed` — routing.yaml write failed: %{detail}

### `session_unbind_chat`

**slash:** `/session:unbind-chat`

**module:** `Esr.Commands.Session.UnbindChat`

**permission:** `null`

**bindings:** requires_user_binding=`true` requires_workspace_binding=`false`

**description:** 离开当前 session;session 保持运行;可省略 session= 默认 unbind 当前

**args:**
  - `session` (optional) — session UUID v4 (defaults to current)

**errors:**
  - `invalid_args` — /session:unbind-chat requires a chat context (chat_id + app_id in envelope)
  - `invalid_session_uuid` — session unbind-chat requires a UUID; use /session:list to see available sessions
  - `no_current_session` — no session is currently attached to this chat; pass session=<uuid> explicitly

### `workspace_add_folder`
